parts.headline: AI Spending Has Met Its First Real Bill

numbers.label: Alphabet Q2 free cash flow
numbers.context: Hayden Capital; Q2, first negative since 2004 IPO

mentions.excerpt: Hayden Capital’s second-quarter letter explains why the vote changed.

sides.claim: The current hyperscaler capex boom, with Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft together spending close to $800 billion in 2026, requires external capital funding for the first time because capex now exceeds internal cash flow.

AI chip prices are currently inflated by speculative demand from companies ordering more chips than they need to secure allocation, and reselling them at premiums—a dynamic similar to Rolex watch secondary market pricing.
